items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I listened to some of the things that Wynton’s doing now... they’ll ask me the question well what do you think about what Wynton’s doing down at Jazz at Lincoln Center.

ctx.x: Now I’ve got to listen to it again.

That’s Lester Bowie playing that very [scats]. That’s him. As a matter of fact I listened to some of the things that Wynton’s doing now, more recently, and he’s doing Lester. I mean a lot of the things, as much as he may have objected at one point or another to Lester, the thing is when he’s doing a lot of his half-valve thing, he does a whole piece of half-valve, that’s Lester. There’s no other trumpet player that played like that. You know? So a lot of things that he’s doing, whether he wants to admit it or…
Are you still — you said you retired from teaching just recently?
